description: This file defines an AI module for selecting moves in a chess game. It includes functions for choosing a move with minimax algorithm, fallback strategies, and utility functions for evaluating move quality.

methods.name: chooseAiMove(position, { depth = 2, fallbackGreedy = true } = {})
methods.description: Selects a move for the current side using minimax with alpha-beta pruning, with fallback to greedy move selection if necessary.

methods.name: pieceValue(t)
methods.description: Returns numerical value assigned to a piece type, used for move evaluation during greedy capture prioritization.

methods.name: minimaxRoot(position, depth, maximizing)
methods.description: Computes the best move by evaluating all legal moves at the root using minimax algorithm.

methods.name: minimax(position, depth, alpha, beta, maximizing)
methods.description: Performs recursive minimax evaluation with alpha-beta pruning to score game positions.
